titre: Les foyers américains possédant un animal

Au moins un animal.texte: In 2025, U.S. pet ownership remained stable, with 95 million U.S. households owning at least one pet.

Un chien.texte: Ownership expanded from 51% of U.S. households in 2024 to 53% in 2025 (71 million U.S. households)

Un chat.texte: Cat ownership remains a key growth driver in 2025, increasing 5% year over year in 2025, at 39% of U.S. households (53 million)
